sources.title: Llama 3.2 | Model Cards and Prompt formats - developer.meta.com
sources.snippet: Llama 3.2 Quantized Models (1B/3B) Introduction Llama 3.2 included lightweight models in 1B and 3B sizes at bfloat16 (BF16) precision. Subsequent to the release, we updated Llama 3.2 to include quantized versions of these models. This section describes these updated lightweight models, how to obtain them, and what use cases they support.
